SGSS Mombasa Medical Fund

Secure medical fund management portal with donor tracking, patient records security, and real-time reporting for a community healthcare organisation.

WordPress PHP MySQL Security Hardening
// the challenge

Business Challenge

SGSS Mombasa needed a centralised digital platform to manage their community medical fund - replacing spreadsheet-based tracking of donor contributions, patient records, and fund disbursements. Data integrity and patient privacy were paramount concerns.

// our approach

Engineering Approach

We engineered a WordPress-based portal with custom post types for donor management, patient records, and fund allocation tracking. Security hardening was applied at every layer: SSL enforcement, role-based access control, and encrypted data storage for sensitive patient information. Real-time dashboards were built to give administrators immediate visibility into fund balances and disbursement patterns.

Business Results & Metrics

  • Secured Patient Records
    All sensitive patient data encrypted at rest and in transit, with role-based access ensuring only authorised staff can view records.
  • Transparent Fund Management
    Real-time dashboards replaced manual spreadsheets, providing instant visibility into contributions and disbursements.
  • Community Trust
    A professional digital presence strengthened donor confidence and community trust in the fund's operations.
